Definition
[parallel-invariant fiber set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0038 1. ch10:10.10\group Bundle maximum principles

A subset $\mathcal K\subset V$ is parallel invariant if parallel translation along every base path maps each fiber section of $\mathcal K$ into $\mathcal K$.
